g.text: How much packaging each designer's silicon needs

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: CoWoS packaging wafers consumed per logic wafer, by designer and quarter. Both columns are published side

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: by side and never plotted against each other; the ratio is a property of the chip design, and it separates the four

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Components (CC-BY) — quarterly_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-components

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI Chip Components methodology; every figure is a Monte Carlo median over 10,000 draws

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Ratio of two published medians in the same row, so it inherits their uncertainty and is not itself a simulated quantity. In Q4 2025

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: AMD consumed 4.35 CoWoS wafers per logic wafer against 1.12 for NVIDIA. A high ratio means large packages carrying many HBM stacks

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: around a relatively small die; a low one means more dies per package or smaller packages. Because both series are assigned to the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: quarter the component was consumed rather than the quarter the chip shipped, a chip in work-in-process can consume logic with no

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: CoWoS yet, which is what pulls a designer's ratio down in a ramp quarter. Every designer records logic wafers in all eight quarters,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: so no line is interpolated across a gap.
